If you’ve ever scrolled through Prime Video wondering why the recommendations are so terrible, you’re not alone. The platform is packed with great movies… but the algorithm often buries them beneath a mountain of popular movies and low-effort suggestions.

So in this video I’m highlighting 10 great movies on Prime Video that the platform continuously refuses to recommend. These are the kinds of underrated films that slip through the cracks or simply hidden by Prime Video’s messy interface.

If you’re looking for the best movies on Prime Video that you haven't already seen, this list should give you plenty to add to your watchlist. These are the types of movie discoveries that make scrolling through streaming services worth it.
